@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")
@Override
public ResponseEntity<OwnerDto> addOwner(OwnerFieldsDto ownerFieldsDto) {
    HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
    Owner owner = ownerMapper.toOwner(ownerFieldsDto);
    LocalDate registrationDate = BusinessDay.adjust(
        owner.getRegistrationDate() != null ? owner.getRegistrationDate() : LocalDate.now());
    owner.setRegistrationDate(registrationDate);
    Collection<Owner> owners = this.clinicService.findAllOwners().stream().filter(existing -> !existing.isDeleted()).toList();
    if (owners.stream().filter(existing -> registrationDate.equals(existing.getRegistrationDate())).count() >= 100) {
        return new ResponseEntity<>(HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS);
    }
    if (owners.stream().anyMatch(existing -> existing.getIdentityKey().equals(owner.getIdentityKey()))
            || owners.stream().filter(existing -> existing.getCity().equalsIgnoreCase(owner.getCity())).count() >= 50) {
        return new ResponseEntity<>(HttpStatus.CONFLICT);
    }
    owner.setNamesakeCount((int) owners.stream()
        .filter(existing -> existing.getFirstName().equalsIgnoreCase(owner.getFirstName())
            && existing.getLastName().equalsIgnoreCase(owner.getLastName()))
        .count());
    if (owners.stream().anyMatch(existing -> sameHousehold(existing, owner))
            && !Boolean.TRUE.equals(ownerFieldsDto.getSharesHousehold())) {
        return new ResponseEntity<>(HttpStatus.CONFLICT);
    }
    owner.setHouseholdMemberCount(1 + (int) owners.stream().filter(existing -> sameHousehold(existing, owner)).count());
    owner.setCustomerCode(CustomerCode.of(owner, owners));
    owner.setPossibleDuplicate(false);
    owner.setPossibleDuplicateOf(null);
    this.clinicService.saveOwner(owner);
    OwnerDto ownerDto = ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner);
    ownerDto.setBulkSignupWarning(owners.stream()
        .filter(existing -> registrationDate.equals(existing.getRegistrationDate())).count() > 80);
    headers.setLocation(UriComponentsBuilder.newInstance()
        .path("/api/owners/{id}").buildAndExpand(owner.getId()).toUri());
    return new ResponseEntity<>(ownerDto, headers, HttpStatus.CREATED);
}
```

7. `telephone` — `@NotNull`, `@Size(1..20)`, `@Pattern` (phone shape), plus custom `@E164NationalLength` (national-digit count must match country code, e.g. `+61`→9, `+1`→10).
8. `email` — `@Size(max 255)`, `@Email`, plus custom `@NonDisposableEmail` (rejects `mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`).
9. `postcode` — `@Pattern(^\d{4}$)`.
10. `registrationDate`, `birthDate` — `@PastOrPresent`.
11. `title` — `@Size(1..10)`.
12. **Class-level `@ValidPostcode`** — cross-field: the 4-digit postcode must fall in the city's region range (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099). Blank postcode or unknown region passes.

## Stage 2 — Mapping DTO → `Owner` entity (`OwnerMapper.toOwner`)

These are normalization side-effects that run inside the entity's setters as the mapper populates it:

13. **Email lowercased** (`setEmail`).
14. **Telephone normalized to E.164** via `PhoneNumbers.toE164` (`setTelephone`).
15. **Address normalized** via `AddressNormalizer.normalize` and recomposed (`setAddress`/`setAddressLine1`/`setAddressLine2`).

## Stage 3 — Controller business logic (`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`), in order

16. **`registrationDate` rolled forward to a business day** via `BusinessDay.adjust` (skips weekends and hardcoded 2026 holidays); defaults to today if absent.
17. Loads all non-deleted owners for the checks below.
18. **Rate-limit check** — if ≥ 100 owners already share that registration date → return `429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` (aborts, no save).
19. **Identity / city-cap check** — if an existing owner has the same `identityKey` (telephone + email) **OR** ≥ 50 owners already exist in the same city → `409 CONFLICT` (aborts).
20. **`namesakeCount` set** = number of existing owners with the same first + last name (case-insensitive).
21. **Household-duplicate guard** — if any existing owner is in the same household (last name + postcode) and the request did **not** set `sharesHousehold=true` → `409 CONFLICT` (aborts).
22. **`householdMemberCount` set** = 1 + existing owners in the same household.
23. **`customerCode` computed** via `CustomerCode.of` (`<REGION>-<sha256 hash8>`, with `-n` suffix to dedup against existing codes).
24. **`possibleDuplicate` set to `false`; `possibleDuplicateOf` set to `null`.**

## Stage 4 — Persistence (`ClinicService.saveOwner` → `ownerRepository.save`)

The service is a thin `@Transactional` pass-through — no password encoding, no events, no email.

25. **`@PrePersist` `defaultRegistrationDate`** — sets `registrationDate` to today if still null (defensive; controller already set it).
26. **`save`** inserts the row.
27. **`@PostPersist` `OwnerAuditListener.onCreate`** — writes an **audit log line** (`AUDIT` logger) with id, customerCode, registrationDate, computed membership level, and membership number.

## Stage 5 — Response assembly

28. Maps saved entity → `OwnerDto`.
29. **`bulkSignupWarning` set to `true`** if > 80 owners share the registration date.
30. Sets `Location: /api/owners/{id}` header and returns **`201 CREATED`**.

## Notes on things that are *not* in this path
- **No password encoding / no email sending / no event publishing** anywhere in owner creation (the `BCryptPasswordEncoder` exists only for user authentication).
- A `DataIntegrityViolationException` at save time is mapped by the advice to **`404`** (not the more conventional 409) — worth flagging as unusual, though you asked only to read, not change.
- The create endpoint is served by the **V1** controller; `OwnerRestControllerV2` only implements the GET list.
